tool_schemas.name: search_locations
tool_schemas.description: Searches the location catalog using the provided free-text query (optionally filtered by category and ordered by the requested sort) and returns a paged list of matching locations; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and omit cursor to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed for this query, or category/sort is not one of the supported values. Raises RATE_LIMITED when search quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected failures.

query.description: Free-text search query for matching locations (name/city/region/country).

category.description: Optional location category to filter results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_nearby_locations
tool_schemas.description: Finds catalog locations within the requested radius of the provided latitude/longitude (optionally filtered by category and ordered by the requested sort) and returns a paged list of nearby results; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and omit cursor to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if latitude/longitude are out of bounds, radius_km is negative, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed for this query, or category/sort is not one of the supported values. Raises RATE_LIMITED when nearby-query quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected failures.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_location_details_tool
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the essential trip-planning details for a single location identified by location_id and returns the location record (including its core geo and category attributes when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if location_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND when no catalog location exists for the given location_id and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected failures.

tool_schemas.name: plan_vacation
tool_schemas.description: Starts a vacation-planning run from the provided structured user_prompt (optionally grounded by destination_query and constrained by start_date/end_date) and returns a confirmation that planning has been initiated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_prompt is missing/empty, dates are not valid ISO 8601 date-times, or end_date is earlier than start_date. Raises RATE_LIMITED when planning quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected failures.

user_prompt.description: Structured natural-language prompt describing the trip to plan.

destination_query.description: Destination text (e.g., city/region/country) used to ground planning.

plan_title.description: Optional title for the vacation plan.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling API key identity and current entitlement/usage snapshot, including status, daily_request_limit, daily_requests_used, and the active usage window. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the presented credential is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

tool_schemas.name: get_vacation_plan
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single vacation plan by id and returns its current status and generated outputs (when available). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the plan id does not exist or is not visible to the calling API key, and FORBIDDEN if the API key is not entitled to access the plan.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

vacation_plan_id.description: Primary identifier of the vacation plan (vacation_plans.id).

tool_schemas.name: list_vacation_plans
tool_schemas.description: Lists vacation plans created under the calling API key, optionally filtered by status and ordered by creation time descending; returns a paged list with an opaque cursor for pagination. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed cursor/limit and UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

limit.description: Maximum number of plans to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: update_vacation_plan_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a vacation plan to a new lifecycle state using an allowed transition (draft→planning/cancelled, planning→ready/failed/cancelled). Returns the updated plan status. Refuses with CONFLICT when the transition is not permitted from the current state, NOT_FOUND when the plan does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when the plan is not owned by the calling API key.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

vacation_plan_id.description: Primary identifier of the vacation plan (vacation_plans.id).

status.description: Target status to transition the plan to; must be a valid next state.

error_code.description: Optional error code to set when transitioning to failed.

error_message.description: Optional human-readable error message to set when transitioning to failed.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_vacation_plan_item
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new itinerary item or updates an existing one within a vacation plan. Items are writable only while the parent plan status is draft or planning; returns the stored item. Refuses with CONFLICT when the plan is ready/cancelled/failed, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid times/indices, and NOT_FOUND for missing foreign keys (plan or location).

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

vacation_plan_item_id.description: If provided, updates the existing item with this id; if omitted, a new item is created.

day_index.description: 0-based day index within the trip window.

sequence.description: 0-based ordering of items within the day.

location_id.description: Optional location reference (locations.id). Required when item_type represents a place-based stop.

ends_at.description: Optional end time in ISO 8601; must be >= starts_at when both provided.

status.description: Lifecycle status for the item; must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: list_vacation_plan_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists itinerary items for a vacation plan, optionally filtered by day_index and status, ordered by (day_index, sequence). Returns a paged list with an opaque cursor. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when the plan does not exist and FORBIDDEN when the plan is not owned by the calling API key.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent exactly as issued).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

metadata.name: TripAdvisor Vacation Planner
